body:
**RAV-RUN1-R1-F001 [high] source-provenance** — The adapter replaces the source record's dataset name in `source_data.dataset_name` with a routing task slug

The source record already supplies the dataset name, but this line replaces it with a routing slug. Published records then identify task collections instead of datasets such as `CTI-Bench MCQ`.

Please keep the upstream name in `source_data`. Please use an explicit sayf-eval collection override for routing.

**RAV-RUN1-R1-F001 [medium] packaging-test** — Conditional self-references count as universal bundle edges

The prefix regex captures the project and extras but leaves a PEP 508 marker unexamined. A win32-only self-reference then satisfies this test on Linux even though installing `[all]` there omits that extra.

Please use a PEP 508 parser that distinguishes markers while preserving valid unmarked version and URL forms. Please add focused marker and direct-reference cases to cover both sides.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F003 [high] score-scaling** — The adapter divides a group by 100 when its median is out of range and 90 percent then fit. This decision ignores source scale evidence.

Please make rescaling require an explicit recognized marker and compatible canonical definition. Please keep other out-of-range cells out of publication. Please retain their raw provenance in the failure report.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F006 [medium] runtime-dependencies** — The default download path needs `huggingface_hub` 1.x, but the project requires a version below 1.0

The declared environment exits before download.

Please use `--dump` in the current environment until the declared client supports bucket access.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F001 [medium] source-row-accounting** — The parser visits only rows that match the exact three-cell pattern

A changed cell or score can disappear before failure accounting, and `total_records` then counts only the rows that parsed. The current page matches this shape, but a future markup change can still publish incomplete output as successful.

Please make each bounded table return valid rows and structured failures together, including duplicate model-metric rows.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F004 [medium] packaging** — The package-data list omits `every_eval_ever/adapters/lexam/registry_snapshot.json`

A built wheel then falls back to `unknown` registry revision and metric review status during LEXam conversion.

Please include the exact snapshot path or a deliberate snapshot pattern in package data. Please add a wheel-install test covering the installed-package path.
